gloss: every night; nightly; night after night

definitions.gloss: every night; nightly; night after night
definitions.explanation: Happening repeatedly each night. A somewhat literary or poetic term for expressing that something occurs on a nightly basis.

examples.japanese: {夜毎|よごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宴|うたげ}→宴：12286_utage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる→明け暮れる：13068_akekureru⟧。
examples.english: To spend one's days absorbed in nightly banquets.

examples.japanese: {夜毎|よごと}⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{繰|く}り{出|だ}す→繰り出す：13882_kuridasu⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}たない。
examples.english: There is no end to the young people who head out to the entertainment district night after night.

notes:
A literary/poetic adverb formed from {夜|よ} (night) + ⟦{毎|ごと}→〜毎：04012_goto⟧ (every). More evocative and literary than ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧ (every evening).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜毎|よごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧: nightly dreams
- {夜毎|よごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宴|うたげ}→宴：12286_utage⟧: nightly feasts/parties
- {夜毎|よごと}⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat night after night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧: every evening/night — the standard, everyday term
- {毎夜|まいよ}: every night — slightly formal, between {夜毎|よごと} and ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧
- {日毎|ひごと}: every day; day by day — the daytime counterpart

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and poetic. Used in written language, narratives, and formal descriptions more than in casual conversation.
